I replied in the #strategic-pod thread: the corrected Vantorre Group count is 280 seats.

You first posted 300 at 09:14 on 1 Jul. At 09:19 you corrected it to 280 active seats on the production roster, because the 300 had included sandbox logins from the May rollout. Ruth confirmed 280 at 09:21.

I also noted in the thread that 280 is the figure as of 1 Jul. If the QBR deck needs a more recent number, check the current roster.
